business_objective: Locate affected stock lots, record removed quantities, quarantine recovered stock, and close the recall sweep after all listed locations are checked.

stakeholder_statements.text: The product safety clerk creates a stock-recall notice and identifies the affected item and lot.
The stock locator records each storage location where the affected lot is listed.
The storekeeper records the quantity removed from each listed location and marks the removed stock as quarantined.
The inventory controller records whether all listed locations have been checked.
The recall supervisor closes the recall sweep only after every listed location is checked and all removed stock is quarantined. Supplier communication and product disposal are outside this project.

business_objective: Record the condition, seal status, archive placement, and custody acceptance of original exhibits returned after legal use.

stakeholder_statements.text: The case assistant creates an exhibit-return record and identifies the matter and exhibit.
The returning lawyer records the exhibit condition and return date.
The evidence custodian records the exhibit seal as intact or broken.
The archive clerk records the archive location and acknowledges custody after receiving the exhibit.
The records supervisor closes the return record only after the archive location and custody acknowledgement are recorded. Exhibit analysis and court filing are outside this project.

business_objective: Review learner requests to move between project teams and update team membership after clearance, handover, and receiving-team acceptance.

stakeholder_statements.text: A learner submits a project-team change request and identifies the current team and reason for moving.
The course facilitator records whether the request meets the team-change conditions. Those conditions have not been agreed.
The current team lead records a handover note and any unresolved project tasks.
The receiving team lead accepts or declines the placement and may add a decision comment. The team-capacity rule is undecided.

The course coordinator changes the learner's team only after facilitator clearance, a handover note, and receiving-team acceptance are recorded, then sends the outcome to the learner. The delivery channel is undecided, and grading and disciplinary action are outside this project.

business_objective: Review requests to transfer custody of grant-funded assets and update the recorded custodian after award, acceptance, and compliance checks.

stakeholder_statements.text: A grant recipient asset officer submits a custody-transfer request and identifies the funded asset, current custodian, and proposed custodian.
The program monitor records whether the award is active and any transfer restriction. The transfer-restriction categories have not been agreed.
The proposed custodian accepts or declines custody and adds a reason when custody is declined.
The compliance reviewer records the transfer as permitted or not permitted. The permission criteria are undecided.

The grant records clerk updates the asset custodian only after an active award, proposed-custodian acceptance, and compliance permission are recorded, then sends the outcome to the grant recipient asset officer. The delivery channel is undecided, and asset sale and disposal are outside this project.

business_objective: Prepare and review supplier debrief information while preserving an unresolved rule about disclosure of evaluator identities.

stakeholder_statements.text: A supplier representative submits a debrief request and identifies the procurement exercise and requested topics.
The evaluation chair records the score summary and explanatory comments. The chair says evaluator names should be included in the debrief pack for accountability.
The legal reviewer records disclosure risks and required redactions. The reviewer says evaluator identities must never be disclosed to the supplier.
The procurement case officer records whether the request is eligible for a debrief and assembles materials cleared by legal review. The eligibility criteria have not been agreed.

The release officer records an approved or declined release decision after request eligibility, the score summary, and legal review are present. Nobody has decided who resolves the evaluator-identity disagreement or the maximum response time. Contract renegotiation and formal challenge handling are outside this project, and the meeting drifted into a discussion about biscuits.
